# Little League Baseball and Softball

> > The world's largest organized youth sports program, featuring Little League Baseball and Softball World Series tournaments, the Challenger Division, and comprehensive resources for players, coaches, and volunteers.

Little League International operates global youth baseball and softball programs from its headquarters in South Williamsport, Pennsylvania, home to the iconic Little League World Series and the World of Little League Museum. The organization serves millions of young athletes through local leagues, regional tournaments, and championship events including the Little League Baseball World Series, Junior League Baseball World Series, and various softball divisions.

## Key Topics

- Little League World Series
- Little League Baseball World Series

## World Series Events & Championships

- [Little League Baseball and Softball](https://www.littleleague.org): Homepage for world's largest youth sports program with safety resources
- [Challenger Game](https://www.littleleague.org/world-series/2022/jlsws/challenger): Challenger Program exhibition game at Junior Softball World Series
- [Closing Ceremonies](https://www.littleleague.org/world-series/2022/jlsws/closing-ceremonies): Junior League Softball World Series closing ceremony details
- [Accessibility](https://www.littleleague.org/world-series/2018/llbws/accommodations-persons-disabilities): Wheelchair access and disability accommodations at World Series venues
- [Directions and Parking](https://www.littleleague.org/world-series/2018/llbws/directions): Directions, parking, and travel info for Williamsport World Series venue
